text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Kuwaiti Stock Exchange index rose 6.1 points on Wednesday to 1,913.2.
- Kuwait aviation workers suspended a planned strike for two weeks on request from prime minister.
- Trade minister says Kuwait's imports from Syria amounted to 21 million dinars ($70 million) in 1995.
- Health minister says Kuwait's environment is still suffering the impact of Iraq's 1990-91 occupation.
- Kuwait welcomes Iraq's approval of oil-for-food terms.
- Kuwait signs an aviation pact with Georgia.
- Criminal Court clears Kuwaiti female lawyer of spying charges.
